hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has separate entries for Gundungurra [xrd] and Ngunawal [xul] but they are close enough linguistically to be one and the same language, called Northern Inland Yuin by **hh:hvw:Waferetal:New-South-Wales**. See also: Northern Inland Yuin [NOCODE_Northern-Inland-Yuin].

endangerment.comment: Ngunawal (6682-xul) = Awakening (The Ngaiyuriija Ngunawal Language Group, comprises a number of Ngunawal family groups and Ngunawal Aboriginal Corporations – Thunderstone Cultural and Land Management Services Aboriginal Corporation, Koomurri Ngunawal Aboriginal Corporation and Ngunawal Heritage Aboriginal Corporation – are working with AIATSIS to develop a language program for primary and secondary school students and teachers.) [Bell and Bell n.d.](cldf:bell:bell:nd)
